56300.commentary: (ANa) sakadāgāmipatto tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno'ti sakadāgāmipuggalo hutvā tusitabhavaney'eva nibbatto.

56301.meaning1: returning (only) once; who has attained the second stage of the path
56301.meaning2: who has attained the second stage of the Path and to be reborn on the earth only once

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino saki'd'eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr'ime bhūtā sot'āpanno, sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmi, sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī, anāgāmīphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā, arahattāya paṭipanno

56302.meaning1: muddy; full of mud; filthy; dirty

examples.text: tesaṃ'y'eva kho pana, bhikkhave, mahānāgānaṃ anusikkhamānā taruṇā bhiṅkacchāpā taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā na suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā sakaddamaṃ asaṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.

56303.meaning1: one's own community; one's own circle; one's own group

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo sagavacaṇḍo hoti, no paragavacaṇḍo? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sakaparisaṃ ubbejetā hoti, no paraparisaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo sagavacaṇḍo hoti, no paragavacaṇḍo.

56304.commentary: (VINa) yena sakapitu nivesanan'ti yena sakassa pitu attano pitu nivesanan'ti attho, thero pitari pemen'eva subbaco hutvā agamāsi.

examples.text: thullakoṭṭhike sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caramāno yena sakapitu nivesanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami. tena kho pana samayena āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa pitā majjhimāya dvārasālāya ullikhāpeti.

56307.commentary: (VINa) sakabaḷenā'ti ettha dhammaṃ kathento harītakaṃ vā laṭṭhimadhukaṃ vā mukhe pakkhipitvā katheti. yattakena vacanaṃ aparipuṇṇaṃ na hoti, tattake mukhamhi sante kathetuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: na sakabaḷena mukhena byāharissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na sakabaḷena mukhena byāharitabbaṃ. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca sakabaḷena mukhena byāharati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

56308.meaningLit: rule about (speaking with a mouthful of) food

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā brahmadevo pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi. sāvatthiyaṃ sapadānaṃ piṇḍāya caramāno yena sakamātu nivesanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami. tena kho pana samayena āyasmato brahmadevassa mātā brāhmaṇī brahmuno āhutiṃ niccaṃ paggaṇhāti.
vātaṃ vā so jālena bādhetabbaṃ maññeyya, yo vitakkavicāre nirodhetabbaṃ maññeyya, sakamuṭṭhinā vā so gaṅgāya sotaṃ āvāretabbaṃ maññeyya, yo vitakkavicāre nirodhetabbaṃ maññeyyā'ti.

56314.meaning1: one's own deeds; one's own actions
56314.commentary: (MNa) sakammunā haññatī'ti attanā katakammavasena kasāhi'pi tāletī'ti-ādīhi kammakāraṇāhi haññati. (THa) sakammunā tena attano sandhicchedakammunā kāraṇabhūtena kas'ādīhi tāḷan'ādi-vasena haññati rājapurisehi bādhiyyati bajjhati ca.

examples.text: coro yathā sandhimukhe gahito, sakammunā haññati pāpadhammo, evaṃ pajā pecca paramhi loke, sakammunā haññati pāpadhammo.
akammakā'pi dhātavo sopasaggā sakammakā'pi bhavanti, tasmā kammani anupubbā bhūdhātuto vattamān'attanopada-paṭhamapuris'ekavacanaṃ te.

56316.meaning1: engaged in one's own work; busy with one's own affairs
56316.meaning2: engaged on one's own work; busy with one's own activities

examples.text: te ca manussā sakammapasutā rañño janapadaṃ na viheṭhiṃsu, mahā ca rañño rāsiko ahosi.

56317.meaning1: with work still to be done; with something left to do
56317.meaning2: who still has something to do
56317.commentary: (THa) ahaṃ sakaraṇīyo'mhī'ti satthu parinibbāne upaṭṭhite maṇḍalamāḷaṃ pavisitvā kapisīsaṃ ālambitvā sok'ābhibhūtena vuttagāthā. tattha sakaraṇīyo'mhī'ti dukkhaparijānan'ādinā karaṇīyena sakaraṇīyo amhi.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, kahaṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, ānando'ti? eso, bhante, āyasmā ānando vihāraṃ pavisitvā kapisīsaṃ ālambitvā rodamāno ṭhito, ahañ'ca vat'amhi sekho sakaraṇīyo, satthu ca me parinibbānaṃ bhavissati, yo mama anukampako'ti.
ahaṃ sakaraṇīyo'mhi, sekho appattamānaso, satthu ca parinibbānaṃ, yo amhaṃ anukampako.

56318.meaning1: with an opportunity to do; with an occasion to perform

examples.text: iti sakaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ katattā, nikkaraṇ'okāsānaṃ pubbakiccānaṃ pakatiyā pariniṭṭhitattā, evan'taṃ navavidhaṃ pubbakiccaṃ pariniṭṭhitaṃ hoti.

56319.synonym: kasiṇa, kiṇha, kevalakappa, nissesa, sabbanta, sabbāvant

examples.text: mā h'evaṃ, ānanda, mā h'evaṃ, ānanda! sakalam'ev'idaṃ, ānanda, brahmacariyaṃ, yadidaṃ, kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā.
sakalaṃ lumbinīvanaṃ cittalatāvanasadisaṃ, mah'ānubhāvassa rañño susajjitaṃ āpānamaṇḍalaṃ viya ahosi.

atha naṃ rājā ādāsehi parikkhipāpesi. so attano'va chāyaṃ disvā ñātakā me āgatā'ti maññamāno pakkhena tāḷaṃ datvā mañjussarena maṇivaṃsaṃ dhamamāno viya viravi. sakalanagare manussā mattā viya laḷiṃsu.

56330.commentary: (MNt) kaṭṭh'aggī'ti kaṭṭh'upādāno aggi. sakalik'aggīādīsupi es'eva nayo. saṅkār'aggī'ti kacavaraṃ paṭicca uppanna-aggi.

examples.text: bhavanirodho nibbānaṃ bhavanirodho nibbānan'ti kho me, āvuso, aññā'va saññā uppajjati aññā'va saññā nirujjhati. seyyathā'pi, āvuso, sakalik'aggissa jhāyamānassa aññā'va acci uppajjati aññā'va acci nirujjhati

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yaṃ yadeva paccayaṃ paṭicca aggi jalati tena ten'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati. kaṭṭhañ'ca paṭicca aggi jalati, kaṭṭh'aggitv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati, sakalikañ'ca paṭicca aggi jalati, sakalik'aggitv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati
tena kho pana samayena bhagavato pādo sakalikāya khato hoti.
so taṃ māluvālataṃ khaṇḍ'ākhaṇḍikaṃ chindeyya, khaṇḍ'ākhaṇḍikaṃ chetvā phāleyya, phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā vāt'ātape visoseyya

bhavanirodho nibbānaṃ bhavanirodho nibbānan'ti kho me, āvuso, aññā'va saññā uppajjati aññā'va saññā nirujjhati. seyyathā'pi, āvuso, sakalik'aggissa jhāyamānassa aññā'va acci uppajjati aññā'va acci nirujjhati

56338.meaning1: each one's very own; each one's personal

examples.text: sakasakamhi bhavane, nisīditvāna devatā, hasanti tā mahāhasitaṃ, disvān'accherakaṃ nabhe.

56340.meaning2: appropriate to each and every one's language

56341.commentary: (DNa) idha sakasaññī hotī'ti idha sāsane sakasaññī hoti, ayam'eva vā pāṭho, attano paṭhamajjhānasaññāya saññavā hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: yato kho, poṭṭhapāda, bhikkhu idha sakasaññī hoti, so tato amutra tato amutra anupubbena saññ'aggaṃ phusati. tassa saññ'agge ṭhitassa evaṃ hoti, cetayamānassa me pāpiyo, acetayamānassa me seyyo.

56342.meaning1: perceiving as one's own; regarding as one's own possession
56342.commentary: (VINt) tattha sakasaññissā'ti mayhaṃ santakaṃ idaṃ bhaṇḍan'ti evaṃ sakasaññissa parabhaṇḍam'pi gaṇhato gahaṇe anāpatti, gahitaṃ pana puna dātabbaṃ.

56343.commentary: (ANa) sakasāvā'ti pūtisārena c'eva pheggunā ca yuttā. (ANt) sakasāvā'ti sakasaṭā. ten'āha pūtisārenā'tiādi.

examples.text: yam'idaṃ, deva, cakkaṃ chahi divasehi niṭṭhitaṃ tassa nemi'pi savaṅkā sadosā sakasāvā, arā'pi savaṅkā sadosā sakasāvā, nābhi'pi savaṅkā sadosā sakasāvā.

56344.meaning1: fact of being defective; imperfection; degeneracy (of)

examples.text: taṃ nemiyā'pi savaṅkattā sadosattā sakasāvattā, arānam'pi savaṅkattā sadosattā sakasāvattā, nābhiyā'pi savaṅkattā sadosattā sakasāvattā pavattitaṃ samānaṃ yāvatikā abhisaṅkhārassa gati tāvatikaṃ gantvā ciṅgulāyitvā bhūmiyaṃ papati.

56345.meaning1: one's own doctrine; personal belief system

examples.text: evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā unnādino uccāsaddamahāsaddā ahesuṃ, acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, samaṇassa gotamassa mah'iddhikatā mah'ānubhāvatā, yatra hi nāma sakavādaṃ ṭhapessati, paravādena pavāressatī'ti.
addasaṃsu kho sakkassa devānam'indassa paricārikāyo āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ, disvā ottappamānā hirīyamānā sakaṃ sakaṃ ovarakaṃ pavisiṃsu.
daḷhāya rajjuyā bandhitvā daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā upanibandheyya. atha kho te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā nānāvisayā nānāgocarā sakaṃ sakaṃ gocaravisayaṃ āviñcheyyuṃ.

56347.meaning1: own path; own way; personal method

examples.text: idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, evam'pi titthyā puthuso niviṭṭhā, sak'āyane tattha daḷhaṃ vadānā.
saddhammapūjā'pi nesaṃ tath'eva, yathā pasaṃsanti sak'āyanāni, sabb'eva vādā tathiyā bhaveyyuṃ, suddhī hi nesaṃ paccattam'eva.

56349.commentary: (SNPa) garūnaṃ santikaṃ gacchanto kālena gacche garūnaṃ sakāsaṃ (JAa) sīlavataṃ sakāse'ti keḷisīlānaṃ amhākaṃ santike.

examples.text: kālena gacche garūnaṃ sakāsaṃ, thambhaṃ niraṃkatvā nivātavutti, atthaṃ dhammaṃ saṃyamaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, anussare c'eva samācare ca.
pure tuvaṃ sīlavataṃ sakāse, okkantikaṃ kīḷasi assamamhi, karohare makkaṭiyāni makkaṭa, na taṃ mayaṃ sīlavataṃ ramāma.

santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino saki'd'eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.

56353.meaning1: who has baggage; with possessions; who has worldly attachment
56353.construction:
sa + kiṃ + ci + ana
sakiñci + ana

examples.text: na c'āhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brūmi, yonijaṃ mattisambhavaṃ, bhovādi nāma so hoti, sace hoti sakiñcano, akiñcanaṃ anādānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
sukhino vata ye akiñcanā, vedaguno hi janā akiñcanā, sakiñcanaṃ passa vihaññamānaṃ, jano janasmiṃ paṭibandhacitto.

56354.meaning1: in the sense of having possessions and obstructions

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino saki'd'eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.

56357.meaning1: at the same time; at one moment

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante ānanda, puriso ekaṃ'va nidhimukhaṃ gavesanto saki'd'eva ekādasa nidhimukhāni adhigaccheyya. evam'eva kho ahaṃ, bhante, ekaṃ amatadvāraṃ gavesanto saki'd'eva ekādasa amatadvārāni alatthaṃ bhāvanāya.
tatr'assa kāṇo kacchapo. so vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṃ sakiṃ ummujjeyya.

ye te bhikkhū tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakiṃ'd'eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti, te'pi tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.

56359.meaning1: once in each case; once over time; occasionally
56359.commentary: (THa) saggakāyam'agamaṃ sakiṃ sakin'ti saggagatisaṅkhātaṃ kām'āvacaradevakāyaṃ sakiṃ sakiṃ kadāci kadāci upapajjanavasena agacchiṃ.

examples.text: mānuso'pi ca bhavo'bhirādhito, saggakāyam'agamaṃ sakiṃ sakiṃ, rūpadhātusu arūpadhātusu, n'evasaññisu asaññisuṭṭhitaṃ.

ye te bhikkhū tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakiṃ'd'eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti, te'pi tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.

56361.meaning1: woman who has given birth once

56363.synonym: aṇḍaja, dija, pakkhī, vihaga, vihaṅga, vihaṅgama

examples.text: andhabhūto ayaṃ loko, tanuk'ettha vipassati, sakuṇo jālamutto'va, appo saggāya gacchati.
seyyathā'pi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yen'eva ḍeti sapattabhāro'va ḍeti
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, sakuṇagghi lāpaṃ sakuṇaṃ sahasā ajjhappattā aggahesi.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, himavante pabbate karavīkā nāma sakuṇajāti mañjussarā ca vaggussarā ca madhurassarā ca pemaniyassarā ca, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro mañjussaro ca ahosi vaggussaro ca madhurassaro ca pemaniyassaro ca.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… bhūmikampaṃ disādāhaṃ bhumm'antalikkhaṃ jotisaṃ lok'āyatikaṃ sācakkaṃ migacakkaṃ antaracakkaṃ missak'uppādaṃ sakuṇarutaravitaṃ sikkhā karaṇīyā
sākh'antarehi c'eva pupph'antarehi ca pañcavaṇṇā bhamaragaṇā nānappakārā ca sakuṇasaṅghā madhurassarena vikūjantā vicaranti.
idha pan'assa sakuṇasadisassa cātuddisassa bhikkhuno anucchavikasen'āsanaṃ dassento araññaṃ rukkhamūlan'ti-ādim'āha.

56374.meaning2: art of birds; augury with birds

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… aṅgavijjā vatthuvijjā khattavijjā sivavijjā bhūtavijjā bhūrivijjā ahivijjā visavijjā vicchikavijjā mūsikavijjā sakuṇavijjā vāyasavijjā pakkajjhānaṃ saraparittāṇaṃ migacakkaṃ
saddhā bandhati pātheyyaṃ, sirī bhogānam'āsayo, icchā naraṃ parikassati, icchā lokasmi dujjahā, icchābaddhā puthū sattā, pāsena sakuṇī yathā'ti.
yesaṃ sannicayo n'atthi, ye pariññātabhojanā, suññato animitto ca, vimokkho yesaṃ gocaro, ākāse va sakuntānaṃ, gati tesaṃ durannayā.
yass'āsavā parikkhīṇā, āhāre ca anissito, suññato animitto ca, vimokkho yassa gocaro, ākāse va sakuntānaṃ, padaṃ tassa durannayaṃ.

56378.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in clairvoyance
56378.commentary: (ANa) dibbacakkhukānaṃ yadidaṃ bakulā'ti dibbacakkhukānaṃ, bakulā therī, aggā'ti dasseti. ayaṃ kira padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe nibbattitvā satthu dhammakathaṃ suṇantī satthāraṃ ekaṃ bhikkhuniṃ dibbacakkhukānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. sā kappasatasahassaṃ devesu ca manussesu ca saṃsaritvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sāvatthiyaṃ kulagehe nibbattitvā aparabhāge satthu dhammadesanaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddhā pabbajitvā nacirass'eva arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. sā tato paṭṭhāya dibbacakkhumhi ciṇṇavasī ahosi. aparabhāge satthā jetavane nisinno bhikkhuniyo paṭipāṭiyā ṭhān'antare ṭhapento imaṃ theriṃ dibbacakkhukānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapesī'ti. (THIa) sakulā'tissā nāmaṃ ahosi. sā viññutaṃ pattā satthu jetavanapaṭiggahaṇe paṭiladdhasaddhā upāsikā hutvā aparabhāge aññatarassa khīṇ'āsavattherassa santike dhammaṃ sutvā sañjātasaṃvegā pabbajitvā vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā ghaṭentī vāyamantī na cirass'eva arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. tena vuttaṃ apadāne.
56378.notes: Therīgāthā verses 97-101 (TH5.7, TH44) are attributed to her.

examples.text: itthaṃ sudaṃ sakulā therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ dibbacakkhukānaṃ yadidaṃ sakulā.

tena kho pana samayena sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā paribbājakā moranivāpe paribbājak'ārāme paṭivasanti, seyyath'idaṃ, annabhāro varadharo sakul'udāyī ca paribbājako aññe ca abhiññātā abhiññātā paribbājakā.

56381.meaning1: in one's own teaching; in one's field of expertise

examples.text: vihaññati kho ayaṃ soṇadaṇḍo brāhmaṇo sakena cittena. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ soṇadaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sake ācariyake tevijjake pañhaṃ puccheyyan'ti
karaṇīyam'atthakusalena, yantaṃ santaṃ padaṃ abhisamecca, sakko ujū ca sūjū ca, suvaco c'assa mudu anatimānī.
isisattamassa akuhassa, tevijjassa brahmapattassa, nhātakassa padakassa, passaddhassa viditavedassa, purin'dadassa sakkassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.

56383.meaning1: name of the king of the Devas; Sakka

examples.text: addasā kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ. disvāna sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ etadavoca, tikiccha maṃ devānam'indā'ti
yo vejayantapāsāde, sakkaṃ so paripucchati, api āvuso jānāsi, taṇhakkhayavimuttiyo, tassa sakko viyākāsi, pañhaṃ puṭṭho yathātathaṃ.

56384.meaning1: Sakyan; man of the Sakyan race

examples.text: dv'āhaṃ sakkaṃ apucchissaṃ, na me byākāsi cakkhumā, yāvatatiyañ'ca dev'īsi, byākarotī'ti me sutaṃ.
eko ahaṃ sakka mahantam'oghaṃ, anissito no visahāmi tārituṃ, ārammaṇaṃ brūhi samantacakkhu, yaṃ nissito ogham'imaṃ tareyyaṃ.

56385.meaning1: which makes one Sakka; done by Sakka

examples.text: sakkañ'ca khv'āhaṃ, mahāli, pajānāmi sakkakaraṇe ca dhamme, yesaṃ dhammānaṃ samādinnattā sakko sakkattaṃ ajjhagā, tañ'ca pajānāmi.

56386.grammar: ind, adv, ger of sakkaroti, comp vb
56386.meaning2: having well prepared, honoured, or respected

examples.text: yān'īdha bhūtāni samāgatāni, bhummāni vā yāni va antalikkhe, sabb'eva bhūtā sumanā bhavantu, atho'pi sakkacca suṇantu bhāsitaṃ.

56387.commentary: (SNa) na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī'ti jhānaṃ appetuṃ sakkaccakārī na hoti.

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti, samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī ca. tatra, bhikkhave, yv'āyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.

yaṃ kho pan'assa bhojanaṃ denti, lūkhaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā, taṃ sakkaccaṃ'y'eva paribhuñjati avihaññamāno.
